page_title: SEV 2-2 ELC | Sevilla v Elche 12/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
90+4' A yellow card for a tackle by John Donald (Elche). Javier Alberola doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+3' Referee Javier Alberola halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Matias Almeyda, then shows him a yellow.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Javier Alberola blows his whistle as Isaac Romero (Sevilla) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
88' Eder Sarabia has decided to substitute Martim Neto and he is replaced by John Donald (Elche).
88' The game has come to an end for Adria Pedrosa. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Leo Petrot (Elche).
87' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Sevilla players have a reason to celebrate!
86' The Sevilla players halt their celebrations as referee Javier Alberola makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
85' 2 - 2 Alexis Sanchez feeds the ball through to Peque (Sevilla), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top right corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:2!
84' Sevilla work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
83' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
82' Batista Mendy (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) is replacing Rafa Mir.
80' Eder Sarabia has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hector Fort (Elche) replacing Victor Chust.
79' It's time for a substitution. Peque (Sevilla) comes on in place of Ruben Vargas.
79' Juanlu Sanchez goes off the pitch and Adnan Januzaj (Sevilla) comes on.
76' It looks like Adria Pedrosa (Elche) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
71' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
70' 1 - 2 Rafa Mir (Elche) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the right post.
69' Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
68' The attendance for today's match is 37331.
66' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
64' Sevilla control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
61' Substitution. Alfonso Gonzalez walks off the pitch and Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
61' Substitution. Nemanja Gudelj makes his way off the pitch and Alexis Sanchez (Sevilla) comes on as his replacement.
61' Here is a change. Tanguy Nianzou is going off and Matias Almeyda gives the last tactical orders to Castrin (Sevilla).
60' Substitution. Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) has come on for Ali Houary.
55' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Elche will have a goal kick.
54' 1 - 1 Goal! Andre Silva (Elche) scores after an assist by Martim Neto that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:1.
52' Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
49' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Tanguy Nianzou (Sevilla) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
46' A goal, which was scored by Isaac Romero (Sevilla), was disallowed due to offside.

46' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Matias Dituro has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Elche take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
44' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.
44' Victor Chust (Elche) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
43' Ali Houary (Elche) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
40' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 1:0.
37' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.

36' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The linesman makes the right call and Sevilla will have a corner.
34' Pedro Bigas (Elche) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
31' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.

30' Victor Chust (Elche) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! He sent the ball into the stands. What a miserable header! The ball goes out of play and Sevilla will have a goal kick.

28' 1 - 0 Isaac Romero (Sevilla) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes inside the left post. He couldn't have done it any better. 1:0.
26' The game is interrupted. Marcao (Sevilla) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
25' Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.
23' PENALTY APPEAL by Sevilla, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
20' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 41:59.
17' Elche quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
16' Andre Silva (Elche) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
13' Cesar Azpilicueta (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
12' A player from Elche commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
8' Yellow card. Lucien Agoume (Sevilla) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
6' Alfonso Gonzalez (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' A long-range effort by Ali Houary (Elche) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
2' Marcao (Sevilla) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Elche will take the kick-off.
Javier Alberola will supervise the game today.
